name: BULB Cockpit: Dynamic Route Maps
summary: Dynamic first-person route maps, clickable transfers and custom line badges.
description:
0.1.65dev — Development preview

BULB-inspired native route maps for Transport Fever 3. While riding in first person, the line identity appears at the upper left and the route diagram at the bottom center. No browser, image export or external renderer is required during gameplay.

Features
• RER, Metro, Tramway and bus styles using your game line colors.
• Live stop progress, optional yellow blinking and white stops on branches the current vehicle does not serve.
• Clickable line directory and transfer badges. Bus routes appear after searching.
• Prefix + number/letters + suffix badges, complete-badge search and Apply all.
• Connected lines with the same display type and complete badge form merged branch diagrams only when their actual endpoints connect.
• Optional city / Express bus prefixes. Select two stops on the map to link nearby interchange stops.
• English / Chinese switch on the directory homepage. Save the game to retain your choice. Game line and station names keep their original text.

How to use
Enable the mod when loading your save. In normal map view, open the route-map button at the upper left to browse or configure lines. Enter a vehicle's first-person view to show its dynamic map. The settings button is hidden in first-person view and in the pause menu.

Compatibility
Development build targeting macOS Build 40420. Windows, Linux and consoles have not been tested. Long-session FPS degradation remains under investigation; this is not a stable performance-verified release. Blinking is optional and off by default.

Media and credits
The cover is AI-generated promotional artwork. The other two images are real gameplay screenshots; unchanged full-resolution originals are in the GitHub repository.
Inspired by BULB (https://bulb.slama.io/editor). Not affiliated with or endorsed by BULB, RATP, Île-de-France Mobilités or Urban Games. No commercial Parisine font file is included. RER mark attribution: content/gui/bulb_cockpit/symbols/NOTICE.md.

Source, instructions and issue reports: https://github.com/Languisher/tf3-bulb-cockpit

zh.name: BULB 风格 · 动态车内线路图
zh.summary: 第一人称动态线路图、可点击换乘与自定义线路编号。
zh.description:
0.1.65dev — 开发测试版

为《Transport Fever 3》提供 BULB 风格的原生动态线路图。第一人称中，线路标识位于左上角，站点与换乘图位于底部中央。游戏运行时无需浏览器、导出图片或外部渲染器。

功能
• RER、地铁、电车、公交各自的显示样式，沿用游戏线路颜色。
• 到站进度、可选黄灯闪烁；当前车辆不经过的另一分支站点显示白点。
• 可点击的线路目录与换乘编号；公交通过搜索显示。
• 前缀＋数字／字母编号＋后缀，按最终标号搜索，支持全部应用。
• 同显示类型、同完整标号的线路，实际共同起终点连通时合并为分支线路图。
• 可选城市／Express 公交前缀表；在地图上依次点击两个站点，关联附近换乘站。
• 目录首页切换 English／中文，保存游戏后保留选择；游戏线路名与站名保持原文。

使用
加载存档时启用模组。普通地图视角点击左上角线路图按钮，浏览或设置线路；进入车辆第一人称显示动态线路图。第一人称与暂停菜单中隐藏设置按钮。

兼容与测试状态
开发版针对 macOS Build 40420；Windows、Linux 与主机平台未实测。长时间 FPS 下降仍在排查中，尚未完成稳定性能验证。黄灯闪烁默认关闭，可自行开启。

展示图片与归属
封面为 AI 生成的宣传示意图。其余两张为真实游戏截图，GitHub 提供未修改的完整原图。
受 BULB（https://bulb.slama.io/editor）启发；与 BULB、RATP、Île-de-France Mobilités 和 Urban Games 无隶属或背书关系。不包含 Parisine 商业字体文件。RER 图形来源说明：content/gui/bulb_cockpit/symbols/NOTICE.md。

源码、完整说明与反馈：https://github.com/Languisher/tf3-bulb-cockpit
